content.text: Lowering the ring made the score worse (0.912), so I'm going back to the 0.929 version and exporting it.

I built the eyebolt and exported it to `submission.step`. Its best match against the four reference views was a mean silhouette IoU of **0.929**, with every view between 0.927 and 0.931. The file is one valid solid; it was read back after export and matches the part.

The part, with Z up:
- **Shank:** Ø13 × 18 long, along Z.
- **Collar:** Ø29 × 9 thick, with a low Ø18 × 3 boss on top.
- **Eye:** a round ring 40 across the centre of its circular path, made from a Ø13 bar, standing in the YZ plane (ring axis along X). It sits slightly sunk into the boss.

The final compare render was done before the last rebuild. That rebuild only restored the 0.929 settings, after a later try with the ring sunk lower scored worse (0.912), so the 0.929 score belongs to this exact part. What still doesn't match: the hole through the eye is slightly too small and sits a bit too high next to the reference. An oval ring would probably fit better, but my one try at it scored worse than the round ring, so I left it round.

The part was built with a CadQuery script, so in FreeCAD it is one fixed solid rather than editable features. That doesn't affect the STEP file.
